name: Shiva Texyarn Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1980, Shiva Texyarn Ltd does manufacturing of cotton yarn and technical textile products like coated and laminated fabrics, home textile and other value added products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Divisions:
** Cotton Yarn Manufacturing  **[1]
The company has a robust foundation in cotton yarn manufacturing, focusing on the hosiery segment with medium yarn counts and transitioning toward finer yarn counts. It has installed capacity of 52,416 spindles located near Coimbatore.

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -2.60% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -3.70% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 33.7 to 45.8 days.
